# Toolora — Full API Reference for LLMs and AI Agents

> Complete technical reference. For a concise summary, see https://toolora.replit.app/llms.txt

Toolora provides free browser-based utilities and a paid server-side Agent API. This document covers the Agent API in full detail, including request/response schemas, payment flows, and code examples.

---

## About Toolora

- **Website:** https://toolora.replit.app
- **Type:** Free online tools platform + paid Agent API
- **Privacy:** All browser tools are 100% client-side. No data uploaded. Agent API processes files server-side for the duration of a single request only — nothing is stored.
- **Agent manifest:** https://toolora.replit.app/api/agent
- **Well-known manifest:** https://toolora.replit.app/.well-known/agent.json
- **Docs page:** https://toolora.replit.app/api-docs
- **Usage stats (public):** https://toolora.replit.app/api/agent/stats

---

## Free Browser Tools (Client-Side, No Payment)

All tools run entirely in the browser. URLs: https://toolora.replit.app/tools/<slug>

### PDF Tools
| Name | Slug | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| Merge PDF | pdf-merge | Combine multiple PDF files into one document |
| Split PDF | pdf-split | Extract pages or split a PDF into multiple files |

### Image Tools
| Name | Slug | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| Image Resizer | image-resize | Resize by pixels or percentage, lock aspect ratio |
| Image Compressor | image-compress | Reduce file size with quality control (JPG, PNG, WebP) |
| Image Converter | image-convert | Convert between JPG, PNG, and WebP |

### Text Tools
| Name | Slug | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| Word Counter | word-counter | Words, characters, sentences, paragraphs, reading time |
| Case Converter | case-converter | UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case, camelCase, snake_case |
| Lorem Ipsum Generator | lorem-ipsum | Placeholder text by paragraphs, sentences, or words |
| Markdown Preview | markdown-preview | Live side-by-side markdown editor and HTML renderer |
| Text Diff | text-diff | Compare two texts and highlight additions/removals |

### Developer Tools
| Name | Slug | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| JSON Formatter | json-formatter | Format, validate, and minify JSON with error detection |
| Base64 Encoder/Decoder | base64 | Encode text to Base64 or decode Base64 strings |
| URL Encoder/Decoder | url-encoder | Encode/decode URL query parameters |
| Hash Generator | hash-generator | MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256 cryptographic hashes |
| UUID Generator | uuid-generator | Generate UUID v4 strings in bulk |

### Productivity Tools
| Name | Slug | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| QR Code Generator | qr-generator | Create QR codes from any URL or text, download as PNG |
| Password Generator | password-generator | Strong random passwords with custom length and character sets |
| Unit Converter | unit-converter | Length, weight, temperature, area, speed, volume |
| Color Converter | color-picker | Convert between HEX, RGB, and HSL color formats |
| Timestamp Converter | timestamp-converter | Unix epoch to human-readable date/time and back |

---

## Agent API — Paid, Server-Side (x402)

These endpoints run server-side and handle work that browser tools cannot: parsing uploaded PDFs and fetching remote URLs. Payment is required per request via the x402 micropayment protocol.

**No API key. No subscription. No rate limits on payment.**

---

### Payment Overview

#### Stellar XLM (Live)
- Network: `stellar:mainnet`
- Asset: XLM (native Stellar token)
- Price per request: `0.5 XLM`
- Receiver address: see 402 response or `/api/agent` manifest
- Verification: on-chain via Stellar Horizon API
- Replay protection: each tx hash can only be used once (1-hour window)

#### Solana USDC (Coming Soon)
- Network: `solana:mainnet`
- Asset: USDC (SPL token, mint: `EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v`)
- Price per request: `0.01 USDC` (planned)
- Verification: on-chain via Solana JSON-RPC
- Status: in development — watch `/api/agent` manifest for activation

---

### x402 Payment Flow (Step-by-Step)

**Step 1 — Attempt the endpoint (no payment)**
```
POST https://toolora.replit.app/api/agent/pdf/text
Content-Type: multipart/form-data
```

**Step 2 — Receive 402 Payment Required**
```json
{
  "x402Version": 1,
  "error": "Payment Required",
  "accepts": [
    {
      "scheme": "exact",
      "network": "stellar:mainnet",
      "maxAmountRequired": "0.5",
      "asset": "XLM",
      "payTo": "<stellar_wallet_address>",
      "resource": "https://toolora.replit.app/api/agent/pdf/text",
      "description": "Toolora Agent API — pay per request via Stellar XLM",
      "maxTimeoutSeconds": 120
    }
  ]
}
```

**Step 3 — Send XLM on Stellar**
Send exactly 0.5 XLM (or more) to the `payTo` address on Stellar mainnet. Note the transaction hash.

**Step 4 — Build the X-PAYMENT header**
```python
import base64, json

payload = {
    "txHash": "<your_stellar_tx_hash>",
    "from": "<your_stellar_address>",
    "amount": "0.5",
    "network": "stellar:mainnet"
}
header = base64.b64encode(json.dumps(payload).encode()).decode()
```

**Step 5 — Retry the request with payment**
```
POST https://toolora.replit.app/api/agent/pdf/text
X-PAYMENT: <base64_encoded_json>
Content-Type: multipart/form-data
```

---

### Endpoint Reference

---

#### POST /api/agent/pdf/text

Extract all text content from a PDF file.

**URL:** `https://toolora.replit.app/api/agent/pdf/text`
**Method:** POST
**Authentication:** x402 payment via `X-PAYMENT` header
**Content-Type:** `multipart/form-data`

**Request fields:**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| file | File | Yes | PDF file, max 20MB |

**Response (200 OK):**
```json
{
  "text": "Full extracted text content of the PDF...",
  "pages": 12,
  "words": 4823,
  "chars": 29411,
  "info": {
    "Title": "Document title (if set in PDF metadata)",
    "Author": "Author name",
    "CreationDate": "D:20240101120000"
  }
}
```

**Response fields:**
| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| text | string | Full plain text extracted from all pages |
| pages | number | Total page count |
| words | number | Approximate word count |
| chars | number | Character count (including spaces) |
| info | object | Raw PDF metadata object |

**Use case:** Ingest PDF research papers, reports, invoices, or filings for LLM processing.

**curl example:**
```bash
PAYMENT_HEADER="$(python3 -c "
import base64, json
p = {'txHash':'<hash>','from':'<addr>','amount':'0.5','network':'stellar:mainnet'}
print(base64.b64encode(json.dumps(p).encode()).decode())
")"

curl -X POST https://toolora.replit.app/api/agent/pdf/text \
  -H "X-PAYMENT: $PAYMENT_HEADER" \
  -F "file=@document.pdf"
```

**Python example:**
```python
import requests, base64, json

payload = base64.b64encode(json.dumps({
    "txHash": "<stellar_tx_hash>",
    "from": "<your_stellar_address>",
    "amount": "0.5",
    "network": "stellar:mainnet"
}).encode()).decode()

r = requests.post(
    "https://toolora.replit.app/api/agent/pdf/text",
    headers={"X-PAYMENT": payload},
    files={"file": open("document.pdf", "rb")}
)
print(r.json())
```

---

#### POST /api/agent/pdf/extract

Extract structured sections and headings from a PDF for RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines.

**URL:** `https://toolora.replit.app/api/agent/pdf/extract`
**Method:** POST
**Authentication:** x402 payment via `X-PAYMENT` header
**Content-Type:** `multipart/form-data`

**Request fields:**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| file | File | Yes | PDF file, max 20MB |

**Response (200 OK):**
```json
{
  "title": "Document Title",
  "sections": [
    {
      "heading": "Introduction",
      "level": 1,
      "content": "This paper presents...",
      "wordCount": 312
    },
    {
      "heading": "Methods",
      "level": 2,
      "content": "We conducted...",
      "wordCount": 847
    }
  ],
  "pages": 12,
  "totalWords": 4823,
  "info": { "Author": "...", "CreationDate": "..." }
}
```

**Response fields:**
| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| title | string \| null | Detected document title (first heading found, or null) |
| sections | array | Array of section objects |
| sections[].heading | string \| null | Section heading text (null for preamble before first heading) |
| sections[].level | number | Heading level (1 = top-level, 2 = sub-section, 3 = sub-sub) |
| sections[].content | string | Full plain text of the section body |
| sections[].wordCount | number | Word count of this section's content |
| pages | number | Total page count |
| totalWords | number | Total word count across all sections |
| info | object | Raw PDF metadata |

**Use case:** Chunk a PDF into logical sections for embedding into a vector database. Each section becomes one RAG document with heading as the key.

**curl example:**
```bash
curl -X POST https://toolora.replit.app/api/agent/pdf/extract \
  -H "X-PAYMENT: $PAYMENT_HEADER" \
  -F "file=@document.pdf"
```

**Python example:**
```python
import requests, base64, json

payload = base64.b64encode(json.dumps({
    "txHash": "<stellar_tx_hash>",
    "from": "<your_stellar_address>",
    "amount": "0.5",
    "network": "stellar:mainnet"
}).encode()).decode()

r = requests.post(
    "https://toolora.replit.app/api/agent/pdf/extract",
    headers={"X-PAYMENT": payload},
    files={"file": open("document.pdf", "rb")}
)
data = r.json()
for section in data["sections"]:
    print(f"[{section['heading']}] {section['content'][:100]}...")
```

---

#### POST /api/agent/url/read

Fetch a URL and return clean, readable text content with boilerplate removed.

**URL:** `https://toolora.replit.app/api/agent/url/read`
**Method:** POST
**Authentication:** x402 payment via `X-PAYMENT` header
**Content-Type:** `application/json`

**Request body:**
```json
{
  "url": "https://example.com/article"
}
```

**Request fields:**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| url | string | Yes | Full URL to fetch and parse (must include http:// or https://) |

**Response (200 OK):**
```json
{
  "title": "Article Title",
  "byline": "Author Name",
  "excerpt": "A short summary sentence extracted from the article...",
  "content": "Clean article text without ads, nav, or boilerplate...",
  "wordCount": 1247,
  "url": "https://example.com/article",
  "fetchedAt": "2026-03-30T12:00:00.000Z"
}
```

**Response fields:**
| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| title | string \| null | Page title extracted by Readability |
| byline | string \| null | Author name or byline (if detected) |
| excerpt | string \| null | Short summary or lede extracted from the article |
| content | string | Full plain text content with boilerplate stripped |
| wordCount | number | Word count of the extracted content |
| url | string | The URL that was fetched |
| fetchedAt | string | ISO 8601 timestamp of when the page was fetched |

**Use case:** Give agents a clean view of any web page for research, summarization, or data extraction — similar to Firecrawl but pay-per-use with no key.

**curl example:**
```bash
curl -X POST https://toolora.replit.app/api/agent/url/read \
  -H "X-PAYMENT: $PAYMENT_HEADER" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"url": "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Artificial_intelligence"}'
```

**Python example:**
```python
import requests, base64, json

payload = base64.b64encode(json.dumps({
    "txHash": "<stellar_tx_hash>",
    "from": "<your_stellar_address>",
    "amount": "0.5",
    "network": "stellar:mainnet"
}).encode()).decode()

r = requests.post(
    "https://toolora.replit.app/api/agent/url/read",
    headers={
        "X-PAYMENT": payload,
        "Content-Type": "application/json"
    },
    json={"url": "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Artificial_intelligence"}
)
print(r.json())
```

---

### Error Responses

| Status | Meaning |
|--------|---------|
| 402 | Payment required — includes `accepts` array with payment instructions |
| 400 | Bad request — missing required fields or invalid input (e.g., no file, bad URL) |
| 413 | File too large — PDF exceeds 20MB limit |
| 422 | Unprocessable — file is corrupted, encrypted, or URL content is unreadable |
| 502 | Bad gateway — the target URL could not be fetched (timeout or connection failure) |
| 500 | Server error — transient, safe to retry |

**402 error variants:**
- `"Payment Required"` — No X-PAYMENT header sent
- `"Invalid X-PAYMENT header (expected base64 JSON)"` — Header is malformed
- `"Transaction already used (replay protection)"` — This tx hash was already used
- `"No payment of 0.5 XLM to <addr> found in transaction"` — Wrong amount or wrong recipient
- `"Transaction not successful on chain"` — On-chain verification failed
